classes: The footer, in the institution's deep colour with the woven flag band. Leaves room for the tab bar when one follows it.
The upper part: identity and contact on the left, sections on the right from 64rem.
Logo or initials, name and purpose.
One sentence on what the institution does.
The <address>: postal address, email and phone.
The link to the full contact page.
One section: a <nav> named after it.
A section's heading, linking to the section.
A section's most-used pages (up to five).
The bottom bar: copyright and the required links.
The required links: Accessibility, Privacy, Disclaimer and others.
astro:
<Footer name="National Communications Authority"
  purpose="We regulate communications in Ghana."
  contact={{ email: 'info@nca.org.gh', moreHref: '/contact/' }} />
